data.name: Hustle On High
data.detailed_description: Hustle on High is a fast paced First-Person hack and Slash game where the story starts you are a chaotic creature named Kaz you are the runt of your species, the humans are starting operations to harvest your dimension in order to combat this your military starts a plan to go Thu a portal and bring the fight to them, as the portal starts up you jump in before its fully active you get teleported to a human lab and also sever your connection to your home world as the portal malfunctions leaving you stranded once you arrive you meet a symbiotic companion Nox he becomes your primary weapon, as you clear rooms of the human created creatures they have made you will find canisters that unlock stills that the player can use by sacrificing speed, you can gain speed by kills as well as sliding and wall riding, as you upgrade your skills there will be paths to choose as all our skills have up to 3 different branches you can go down as well as ultimate forms once there max level, As Kaz battles his way through the insane and quirky laboratory managed by your protagonists IV and WYR and all there Creatures organic and mechanical, your mission, Take down all the disastrous creations and make it to the end and have your revenge.
